stories.headline: Searsmont welcomes Lily Robbins home after months of recovery
stories.body: Lily Robbins returned to Searsmont, Maine, on October 30 after five and a half months at Massachusetts General Hospital. First responders escorted her home, where family, friends and neighbors gathered at the fire station to welcome her.

featuredResource.title: Seasonal Climate Change in Vermont: County-level Monthly Temperature and Precipitation Data Compilation for the Forest Products Supply Chain, 1970–2019
featuredResource.description: This PDF report compiles historical monthly temperature and precipitation patterns for Vermont counties using NOAA data. Its tables and comparisons provide context for harvest scheduling, road and trail work, and wood procurement—not a current weather forecast.
